_readme: GRETIL bulk ingestion registry for the Purāṇa and Vedāṅga gaps.
Verified against the live archive on 2026-08-17. Every URL here was fetched;
every marker pattern was read off the actual file, except the three flagged
TWO DISTRIBUTIONS, DIFFERENT LICENCES. The TEI corpus (corpustei/) is
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 — redistributable with attribution, non-commercial. The legacy
1_sanskr/ files carry only 'FOR REFERENCE PURPOSES ONLY! COPYRIGHT AND TERMS
OF USAGE AS FOR SOURCE FILE' — no grant. Prefer TEI plaintext wherever it
exists; entries whose only source is legacy are marked licence: 'reference-only'
and are excluded from the default run.
MARKERS ARE NOT STANDARDISED. Nine sampled files gave nine formats — prefix vs
suffix, '.' vs ',' separators, and //, ||, (), <> or bare delimiters. Hence
'marker' per entry rather than one corpus-wide regex. Named groups: ref1..ref3
for the numeric levels, pada for an optional a-d sub-verse letter.
QUALITY. Sansknet-sourced files state in their own headers: 'word boundaries
are usually not marked by blanks ... The text is not proof-read!'. Those carry
quality: 'unproofed'. Tübingen Purāṇa Project and Hellwig-corrected files are

slash_book_chapter_verse.note: book,chapter.verse wrapped in slashes; closing // is dropped in some plaintext transformations, so it is optional

bare_suffix.note: marker at end of line, no slashes, optional pāda letter

agni_halfverse.note: half-verse markers, zero-padded, single slashes. File also carries '% chapter {N}' markers, ':ś' line prefixes and inline footnote refs (1),(2) that must be stripped

line_start.note: marker at LINE START, inverted relative to every other file

colon_prefix_sutra.note: prefix form used by the śrauta/gṛhya sūtras. Word boundaries are marked with dots, not spaces. Āśvalāyana lines carry a trailing ritual tag like '(darśa: hotṛ)' to strip

angle_prefix.note: Vaitānasūtra. Ambiguity risk: <...> also wraps embedded Atharvaveda quotations mid-line, so anchor to line start

suffix_double_slash.note: Mānava-Gṛhyasūtra: marker trails the sūtra text

apastamba_dharma.note: four levels; ranged refs span several sūtras on one line. Dense analytic markup: '.' compound boundary, '-' decomposed sandhi, '\\' verb marker, '[x[root]' gloss, '( K ... )' Kashi variant

shulba_suffix.note: mūla interleaved with unmarked commentary prose; '--...--' delimits the commentary's lemma citation

nirukta_prefix.note: no siglum, and the SAME ref repeats across many consecutive lines — it marks the section, not the sentence. Do not assume one line per ref

bare_verse_number.note: no siglum at all; flat verse numbering

bare_prefix_three_level.note: no siglum, no slashes; adhikaraṇa.adhyāya.sūtra repeated inline within one giant physical line (Kāmasūtra: 1609 total occurrences, only 63 true ^-anchored), so "style": "prefix" forces prefix extraction without relying on ^ at all

slash_verse_only.note: siglum + flat verse number, no chapter level; closing // optional (dropped in some transforms, e.g. VAnigh)

pipe_chapter_verse.note: Pañcatantra's own convention: double PIPE, not double slash, no internal spaces

texts.name: Viṣṇupurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: 6 aṃśas. Maṅgala verses use ref3 = 0 (ViP_1,1.0).

texts.name: Brahmapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: adhy. 1-246. Pāda-level markers (BrP_1.1a..d) with no slashes; śloka lines get a bare BrP_1.3.

texts.name: Nāradapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: ref1 is the BHĀGA (1 pūrva, 2 uttara), NOT the pāda. The four pādas of the pūrvabhāga are not encoded — adhyāyas run continuously, so the repo's purvabhaga/pada_01..04 split must be derived externally. Lands in purvabhaga/ and uttarabhaga/ only.

texts.name: Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.scope: adhyāyas 1-93; the file's own header says 'Adhy. 94ff. not available at present'
texts.note: Maṅgala uses a non-numeric chapter token: MarkP_Mang.1.

derived.note: GRETIL has no standalone Durgāsaptaśatī; it is sliced out of this file

texts.name: Agnipurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.source_edition: Rajendralal Mitra, Calcutta: Asiatic Society of Bengal 1870-1879 (Bibliotheca Indica 65,1-3)
texts.extra_copyright: Database copyright (C) Jun TAKASHIMA 2001 — record this in source_note
texts.note: 382 adhyāyas. Unique half-verse marker format; needs its own cleanup pass for '% chapter {N}', ':ś' prefixes and inline footnote digits.

texts.name: Liṅgapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.scope: TEI covers pūrvabhāga 1-108 only; uttarabhāga 1-55 is legacy-only (lip_2__u.htm)
texts.note: Hellwig-corrected against the Calcutta 1960 ed. Legacy file keeps the trailing //; the TEI plaintext drops it.

texts.name: Kūrmapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: Both vibhāgas incl. Īśvaragītā. Siglum capitalisation UNVERIFIED — plaintext rendered lowercase 'kūrmp_' but canonical is likely 'KūrmP_'. Match case-insensitively; the siglum itself contains ū (U+016B).

texts.name: Matsyapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: Opening // but no closing // in this file. Maṅgala token MatsP_Mang.1.

texts.name: Garuḍapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: 3 kāṇḍas (Venkaṭeśvara). Siglum capitalisation UNVERIFIED — canonical is almost certainly GarP_.

texts.name: Vāmanapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.note: The Saromāhātmya (inserted after adhy. 23) is a SEPARATE legacy file with its own siglum sequence — import it as a sub-target or it is silently lost.

texts.name: Śivapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.scope: Vidyeśvara-saṃhitā (bk 1) and Vāyavīya-saṃhitā (bk 7) ONLY. Rudra (all 5 khaṇḍas), Śatarudra, Koṭirudra, Umā and Kailāsa saṃhitās are absent from GRETIL entirely
texts.note: Asymmetric delimiters — '//' before, single '/' after: '// ŚivP_1,1.1ab/'. Book 7 adds a part level: '// ŚivP_7.1,1.1ab/'. Ś is U+015A.

texts.name: Skandapurāṇa (critical edition)
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.source_edition: Adriaensen, Bakker & Isaacson, Groningen: Egbert Forsten 1998-
texts.note: Legacy-only, so no redistribution grant. The vulgate khaṇḍas (Māheśvara, Vaiṣṇava, Brahma, Kāśī, Āvantya, Nāgara, Prabhāsa) are NOT in GRETIL.

texts.name: Narasiṃhapurāṇa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.source_edition: ed. Siddheswar Jena, Nag 1987; input Peter Schreiner

texts.name: Vāyupurāṇa — Revākhaṇḍa
texts.author: महर्षिवेदव्यासः
texts.scope: Revākhaṇḍa only — the Vāyupurāṇa proper is NOT in GRETIL
texts.note: Marker sits at LINE START, unlike every other purāṇa file. Target folder does not exist yet; the importer creates it (upapuranas/ is the right home — GRETIL has only this khaṇḍa).

texts.name: Āśvalāyana-Śrautasūtra
texts.author: आश्वलायनः
texts.source_edition: Ramanarayana Vidyaratna, Calcutta 1874 (Bibliotheca Indica 49); input Muneo Tokunaga 1995
texts.note: 12 adhyāyas. Word boundaries are dots, not spaces. Each line carries a trailing ritual-context tag like '(darśa: hotṛ)' — strip it into a separate field.

texts.name: Vaitāna-Śrautasūtra
texts.author: वैतानः
texts.note: '<...>' wraps BOTH the reference and inline Atharvaveda mantra quotations — anchor the regex to line start.

texts.name: Śāṅkhāyana-Gṛhyasūtra
texts.author: शाङ्खायनः
texts.note: Sub-verse letter suffixes occur (śgs_1.1.15ab).

texts.name: Āpastamba-Gṛhyasūtra (with commentaries)
texts.author: आपस्तम्बः
texts.note: Carries TWO commentaries — Haradatta's Anākulāvṛtti and Sudarśana's Gṛhyatātparyadarśana. Consider splitting them into layer folders rather than one flat text.

texts.name: Āpastamba-Dharmasūtra
texts.author: आपस्तम्बः
texts.source_edition: Bühler, Bombay Sanskrit Series LIV & L, 3rd ed. 1932; variants from Kashi SS 93
texts.note: Heavy analytic markup to strip. Ranged refs (ap1.1.1.2-3) cover several sūtras on one line.

texts.name: Gautama-Dharmasūtra
texts.author: गौतमः
texts.note: A second file sa_gautama-dharmasUtra1-3-comm covers adhy. 1-3 with commentary.

texts.name: Āpastamba-Śulbasūtra (with commentaries)
texts.author: आपस्तम्बः
texts.note: Three commentaries interleaved (Kapardin, Karavinda, Sundararāja) as UNMARKED prose between mūla sūtras; '--...--' delimits the lemma citation. A naive parser will fold commentary into the mūla — split on the || marker and treat the run-up text as commentary.

texts.name: Yāska — Nirukta
texts.author: यास्कः
texts.note: The same ref repeats across many consecutive lines — group lines by ref instead of assuming one line per ref. '(x.ṛ)' marks a variant reading. GRETIL has NO separate Nighaṇṭu. The marker ALSO repeats before every sentence within one giant physical line (confirmed against the raw source: only 18 true line-start matches in the whole file, one per adhyaya) — strip_inline below removes the leftover inline repeats after extraction.

texts.name: Lagadha — Ṛgveda-Vedāṅgajyotiṣa
texts.author: लगधः
texts.source_edition: K. V. Sarma, Indian National Science Academy; input Oliver Hellwig
texts.note: 36 verses, ārca recension. The yājuṣa recension is NOT in GRETIL.

texts.name: Kedārabhaṭṭa — Vṛttaratnākara
texts.author: केदारभट्टः
texts.source_edition: ed. Kedāra Nātha Śarmā (Chaukhambha Sanskrit Sansthan, 1980)
texts.note: 6 adhyāyas, 212 sūtra verses (mūla only, no commentary).

texts.name: Vātsyāyana — Kāmasūtra
texts.author: वात्स्यायनः
texts.note: 7 adhikaraṇas, 36 adhyāyas (mūla sūtras only), verified against the well-known 5+10+5+2+6+6+2 adhyāya count. Was grouped at adhikaraṇa level only; the file's adhikaraṇa.adhyāya.sūtra numbers can't safely drive adhyāya-level splitting either (they recur ~1609 times as inline cross-reference citations, not just at true sūtra starts) so the fix uses the file's own 'livre N'/'leçon M' French chapter headers (36 occurrences, one per real adhyāya) instead -- see parse_livre_lecon() in gretil_bulk.py.

texts.name: Jyotirīśvara — Pañcaśāyaka
texts.author: ज्योतिरीश्वरः
texts.note: 5 sāyakas (chapters).

texts.name: Mīnanātha — Smaradīpikā
texts.author: मीननाथः
texts.note: Flat verse numbering only, no chapter division -- one item for the whole text.

texts.name: Nārāyaṇa — Hitopadeśa
texts.author: नारायणः
texts.note: hit_0 (maṅgalācaraṇa/vidyāpraśaṃsā) through the four main sections.

texts.name: Bhāvamiśra — Bhāvaprakāśa Nighaṇṭu
texts.author: भावमिश्रः
texts.note: GRETIL's own header says "to be continued" -- first vargas only (harītakyādi etc.), not the complete Nighaṇṭu. Flat verse numbering, no chapter marker -- one item for what GRETIL carries.

texts.name: Narahari — Rāja Nighaṇṭu
texts.author: नरहरिः
texts.note: rajni_m (maṅgalācaraṇa, alphabetic ref) then rajni_1 through rajni_27 (27 vargas) -- slash_chapter_verse's ref1 pattern accepts both.

texts.name: Vāhaṭa — Aṣṭāṅganighaṇṭu
texts.author: वाहटः
texts.note: Flat verse numbering (VAnigh_1, VAnigh_2, ...), no chapter division -- one item for the whole text. Closing // absent in this file; slash_verse_only's is optional.

not_in_gretil._note: Checked by URL probe (404) and index search. Do not keep re-searching these — look to Muktabodha, SARIT, DCS, TITUS/Frankfurt or archive.org instead.
shiksha: ALL — GRETIL has no Śikṣā section whatsoever. paniniya_shiksha and all 40 named śikṣās are absent
pratishakhya: ALL — rik, taittiriya, vajasaneyi, shaunakiya-chaturadhyayika. The directory named 5_vedang/3_pratis/ is misleading; it holds only the Nirukta and the Ṛgvidhāna
